observation.visible_scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a kitchen: a red/maroon saucepan with a white interior sits on a black glass cooktop, filled with a dark liquid that is actively simmering and giving off steam. A person in a grey shirt is at the left; one hand holds a wooden spoon over the pan, while the other hand is at the pan's handle. A cream-colored counter, a jar lid, and a white container appear in the background.
visible_changes: The wooden spoon begins submerged in the boiling liquid (frames 1-6) and is gradually tilted and lifted until its bowl clears the surface and rises above the pan rim (frames 7-13).

After being lifted, the spoon is held nearly stationary above the pan for the remainder of the clip (frames 14-41), with a thin stream of liquid dripping from it back into the pan around frames 24-31.
The person's upper hand releases the pan handle early (around frames 3-4) and rests on the counter with curled fingers for the rest of the segment.
The dark liquid continues to bubble and steam throughout the excerpt, with the surface pattern changing frame to frame.
The pan, cooktop, and background objects stay in fixed positions, indicating little to no camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The purpose of lifting the spoon (e.g., checking consistency, removing it from the mix) is not shown.
What the dark liquid contains and whether stirring resumes or the pan is taken off the heat after this segment is unknown.
The moments before frame 1 and after frame 41 are not captured.
uncertain_details: Whether the spoon was actively stirring or merely resting in the liquid at the start is not fully clear.
Minor camera drift, if any, is hard to confirm given the static background.
The exact identity of the liquid and the person's other hand's final resting posture beyond the frame edge are not determinable.
